quizzes.question: A sensor stops the wrong connector orientation before the part is fitted. Which level of inspection is this?
quizzes.explanation: It checks the condition that would create the defect, before it happens. That is source inspection — the strongest level.

quizzes.question: Test keeps finding the same loose connector from assembly, so a manager adds an inspector after assembly. What's the better move?
options: Add a second inspector to be safe
Keep the inspector and also fix the cause at assembly
Remove all checks to save cost
Ask test to stop reporting it
quizzes.explanation: An extra inspector can contain the risk for now, but a repeat defect means the process must be fixed at the source — then the temporary check can be removed.
